name: Yang dimension of Singletons plus empty set
proof: This is Yang's delta-function class together with the all-zero function. Yang proves that its canonical ideal has a minimal one-dimensional cellular resolution (equivalently, its canonical-suboplex ring is Cohen--Macaulay of regularity 1), so $\mathrm Y=1$.
references: \cite{yang2018homological}; see the full arXiv version, the delta-functions-plus-zero example.
